name: 28798-visionchat-3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 3.75B params. Ungated, ~7.5 GB; shapes are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup 30%, bounded at 1000 requests, driven in-process through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend rather than over HTTP.
workload: single-turn image+text chat, one 700x700 JPEG plus synthetic text per request, 1000 requests. Prompt text FIXED at 94 tokens, output FIXED at 107. Images are row-index seeded, so every request carries different pixels.
purpose: A single-image visual chat assistant answering short questions for 32 concurrent users on one H100 GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line: a plain, flagless `vllm serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct`.
# Every argument not named here is an engine default, on purpose.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 4096
